messages.subject: Rattle association analysis market basket
parts:
In Rattle I am trying to run a association analysis with the lastfm.csv dataset found here:http://www.biz.uiowa.edu/faculty/jledolter/DataMining/datatext.html

First I remove duplicates on user and artist in excel. Then I load the csv file in rattle ignore the sex and country variable. Then I set the user variable to ident and the artist variable to target.

Next I run an associate analysis with market basket checked. Problem is I get 0 rules from the rattle data.

However, if I use the below code, I get a bunch of rules.

lastfm <- read.csv("lastfm.csv")
library(arules)
playlist <- split(x=lastfm[,"artist"],f=lastfm$user)
playlist <- lapply(playlist,unique)
playlist <- as(playlist,"transactions")
musicrules <- apriori(playlist,parameter=list(support=.01,confidence=.5))
inspect(musicrules)

Why does rattle not produce the same results at the above code?

Any help you can provide is much appreciated.
